summary: Iteration 2 — Phase 2 OurRealm social features QA. Backend: 17/17 new Phase-2 tests pass (test_phase2_social.py) covering username availability (available/reserved/taken/invalid), register with username + auto-friend stealth, /api/users/search, /api/users/featured (incl. stealth widgets), public profile by-username (no auth + 404), full friend lifecycle (request→accept, status transitions, /friends/list hydration), and messaging friends-only (403 for non-friends on POST and thread GET, 200 with persistence once friends, can-message endpoint). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright verified — /signup username field + debounced check (stealth → 'taken' with suggestion chips: stealth90, stealth_hq, the.stealth, stealth.realm), TopStarBar logo navigates to /signup, /home sticky bar has 0 standalone 'Continue' buttons, Friends page renders 3 tabs (Friends/Requests/Find People) with real backend search (stealth result shows Friends badge for newly-registered user thanks to auto-friend), /public/stealth shows FOUNDER + Verified badges and renders 6 widgets, friend-status auto-friended → Message button opens /messages?to=stealth with real-chat-overlay (no blocked state), Profile page shows 'View as Public' button → /public/{me} → 'Switch to Edit' returns to /profile?edit=1, Discover page renders 'Profiles & Their Widgets' swiper with 12 cards (discover-profile-widget-stealth first; mini-widget renders present for stealth's widgets).

minor.issue: get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header. With shared HTTP sessions in tests (and potentially in browsers with mixed cookie/Bearer flows), the cookie from the last auth call always wins, which can silently authenticate the wrong user in multi-account testing or cross-tab scenarios. Not a production bug but worth knowing for QA.
Returns 403 for non-friends without a JSON body matching POST /api/messages — both use detail string, which is fine, but the wording 'Send a friend request first.' is identical (good consistency).

issues: Newly-registered users with no widgets show an empty 'No widgets yet' card that still takes up a full widget slot — looks visually thin next to stealth's rich 4-widget card. Consider sorting users with widgets first (currently sorted by is_founder/is_verified/created_at which is acceptable).

Default own-profile view is currently VIEW mode (editing=false unless ?edit=1). The spec line 'Editing default = Edit mode (toggleable)' is ambiguous; if literal, this is a deviation. Verified flow: 'Edit profile' button toggles into edit mode and 'Save layout' commits; coming from /public via 'Switch to Edit' correctly lands on /profile?edit=1 which DOES open in edit mode. Recommend confirming with PM whether plain /profile should default to editing=true.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm with PM whether bare /profile should default to edit mode; if yes, change Profile.jsx line 352 to `useState(searchParams.get('edit') !== '0')` or similar.
(Optional) In Discover swiper, sort users with non-empty widgets first so empty 'No widgets yet' cards appear after richer cards.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 850+ lines — split into routers/ (auth.py, friends.py, messages.py, profile.py, posts.py) for maintainability.
get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — consider Bearer-first when both are present, OR document the precedence in the API.

Friend system stores usernames (not user ids) in friends/friend_requests_in/out arrays. If a user is ever renamed (no endpoint today but possible), every friend list across the DB breaks. Use user_id instead for relationships.
POST /api/friends/accept does not validate that the corresponding entry exists in target's friend_requests_out (only checks current.friend_requests_in). Edge case if state goes out of sync.

Startup backfill that adds every existing user with a username to stealth.friends will scale badly (O(N) updates on every boot). Move to a one-time migration script or guard with a 'backfill_done' flag.
/api/users/featured does not exclude soft-deleted/blocked users (no such concept yet, but worth planning).
RegisterPayload username regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$` allows starting/ending with '.' which is unusual on social platforms — consider disallowing leading/trailing dot and consecutive dots.
Username 'check' suggestions use random ints inside the handler (`import random as _r` inside function) — move import to module top.
Messaging endpoint lacks pagination (limit 200 hardcoded) — fine for now but document.

Phase-2 file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_social.py uses fresh requests.Session() per user via the `_fresh_user()` helper because the backend prefers cookies over Bearer headers in get_current_user (don't share api_client across multiple authenticated users in the same test). All requested Phase-1+2 features verified working end-to-end against https://realm-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend data-testids that proved reliable: signup-username, signup-username-suggestions, signup-suggest-{name}, signup-submit, header-logo, friends-tab-friends/requests/search, public-status-friends, public-message, public-switch-edit, profile-view-public, profile-edit, real-chat-overlay, discover-profile-widget-{username}, mini-widget-*. The 'View as Public' button requires user?.username to be set (so admin@ourrealm.app, which has no username, doesn't see it — use a registered user or pre-seeded tfone/tftwo).
rca_of_the_issue: Initial 4 backend test failures were a test-setup bug (not a backend bug): the shared `api_client` requests.Session() retained cookies from the most-recent register call, and the backend's get_current_user reads cookies BEFORE the Authorization header, so all calls authenticated as the last-registered user instead of the Bearer-token holder. Fix: introduced a `_fresh_user()` helper that creates a fresh Session per user and explicitly clears cookies, then attaches the Bearer header. All 17 Phase-2 tests pass after the fix.
